gloss.en: AI as teammate reshapes how humans talk to each other, not just to machines.
gloss.zh: AI作为队友，重塑了人与人之间的交流方式，而不仅限于人机对话。

why_now.en: You study human-computer interaction and embodied AI: two new papers show AI teammates distort human-human communication and visual analytics workflows.
why_now.zh: 你研究人机交互与具身AI，两篇新论文显示AI队友会扭曲人际沟通和可视分析流程。

gloss.en: LLMs simplify scientific summaries and integrate urban spatial data, bridging disciplines.
gloss.zh: 大语言模型简化科学摘要并整合城市空间数据，桥接不同学科。

keyword.zh: 大语言模型用于科学空间数据

why_now.en: You follow LLM and technical communication: two papers show LLMs used for science communication and urban data integration.
why_now.zh: 你关注大语言模型与技术传播，两篇论文展示LLM用于科学传播与城市数据整合。
